plainTranslation: Affection and emotional need slightly at odds. What the Venus person offers isn't quite what the Moon person needs to feel cared for. Failure mode: a recurring sense of being loved in the wrong language. Learn the other's actual needs - workable and worth it.
humanMoment: {{holder2}} offers care the only way they know how, but it keeps missing what {{holder1}} needs to feel secure. Both keep trying, and both keep feeling slightly unseen.

summaryDeep: What you need and what they value pull slightly apart. Affection and comfort are a little crossed. Ask for the specific comfort instead of the grand gesture.
tension: Over time, these small misses can start to tell a bigger story. You may begin to think your needs are not important, while they may feel like nothing they do is ever enough. That is when a simple misunderstanding turns into resentment.
advice: Be direct. Tell this person what helps you feel cared for. Ask them what matters to them too. Stop grading each other on mind-reading. This connection gets stronger when you focus less on how love should look and more on whether it is actually reaching the other person.
summaryShort: What you need and what they value pull slightly apart.
